name: @saltand/acp-extension-pi
description: Lody-owned ACP adapter for the native Pi runtime

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const {accessSync}=require('node:fs'); try { for (const arch of ['x64','arm64']) accessSync('native/win32-'+arch+'.node'); } catch { if (process.env.REQUIRE_NATIVE==='1') throw new Error('native/win32-*.node missing'); console.warn('warning: publishing without Windows native modules; process-tree management is disabled on Windows'); }"
